commands.name: quote

options.name: --email
options.description: Contact email to use for the quote reply. Prompts  interactively if omitted.

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: Override the quote endpoint. Also reads the  SENTINEL_QUOTE_ENDPOINT env var.

options.name: --include-context
options.description: Include finding context (file paths, config snippets,  repo path) in the submission. Off by default — send sanitized counts  only.

options.name: --report
options.description: Path to the JSON report produced by `sentinel  scan`.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt. Use in CI.

commands.description: Email a sanitized scan report to Refined Element for a  remediation quote.

commands.name: scan

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: SQL Server connection string for runtime content  checks. If omitted, only static code checks run.

options.name: --event-log-days
options.description: EventLog lookback window in days. Errors and warnings  from CMS_EventLog are grouped within this period (CNT006).

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Fail the process with exit code 2 if any finding has  severity at or above this threshold. One of: Info, Warning, Error, None.  Defaults to None (always exit 0 unless the scan crashes) so adding --fail-on is  an explicit opt-in to PR-gate behavior.

options.name: --keep-clone
options.description: Keep the temporary clone directory instead of deleting it after the scan. Useful for debugging.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to write the HTML and JSON reports. Defaults to ./sentinel-report.

options.name: --path
options.description: Path to the Xperience by Kentico project root (folder  containing the .csproj).

options.name: --quote-endpoint
options.description: Override the quote endpoint baked into the HTML  report's submit button. Also reads the SENTINEL_QUOTE_ENDPOINT env var.  Defaults to Refined Element's production endpoint.

options.name: --ref
options.description: Branch, tag, or ref to check out when using --repo.  Defaults to the repo's default branch.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to scan instead of --path. Accepts  owner/name, github.com/owner/name, or a full URL. Shallow-cloned into a temp dir and removed after the scan.

options.name: --stale-days
options.description: Stale content threshold in days. Items not edited in  this window are flagged.

commands.description: Scan an Xperience by Kentico project (XbyK 29+) for  health issues. Does not support Kentico Xperience 13.
